sample_unit: patients (infants under 90 days admitted to the emergency department)

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy for infant SBI versus pediatricians, ML models, and rule-based methods
links.effect: LLMs performed comparably to ML models, rule-based methods, and pediatrician majority vote (MCC 0.41-0.43 vs 0.43); best individual pediatrician sensitivity 0.74, specificity 0.68, MCC 0.33.
links.quote: In comparison, the best-performing individual pediatrician achieved a higher sensitivity (0.74) but lower specificity (0.68), with an MCC of 0.33, while the pediatricians’ majority vote yielded sensitivity of 0.69, specificity of 0.81, and MCC of 0.43 — comparable to the top-performing LLMs.

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the diagnostic performance of LLMs and ML algorithms to pediatricians for detecting serious bacterial infection in infants using clinical vignettes/data.
